outputs.explanation: Spatial deconvolution heatmap plots overlaid on tissue images; heatmaps do not require individual data point overlays.
Box plots already show the distribution and additionally have individual data points (dots) overlaid for each group.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Bar graph shows log2 fold change values for each gene without any individual data points overlaid; bar charts summarizing data require individual points to be shown.
Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot, so this check does not apply.
